source: ZXNAME0000XZ terminology is not the definition of a ZXNAME0001XZ. ZXNAME0002XZ exposes similar broad concepts with different names and some different widths and mechanisms. HIP explicitly warns portable code not to assume one fixed warp size. ZXNAME0003XZ calls the hardware grouping a wavefront; its size varies by architecture, while ZXNAME0004XZ ZXNAME0005XZ’s warp size is 32.[8]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 术语不是 ZXNAME0001XZ 的定义。 ZXNAME0002XZ 公开了类似的广泛概念，但名称不同，宽度和机制也不同。 HIP 明确警告可移植代码不要采用一种固定的扭曲大小。 ZXNAME0003XZ 将硬件分组称为波前；它的大小因架构而异，而 ZXNAME0004XZ ZXNAME0005XZ 的扭曲大小为 32。[8]
